tagsTab.heading: Tags
tagsTab.idDesc: Unique identifier for the tag. Lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
tagsTab.appliesToDesc: Object types this tag may attach to
tagsTab.paramPolicyDesc: Whether an assignment names a value, as in entity:customer
tagsTab.noValues: No values yet. Add one before making an assignment.
tagsTab.requiredDesc: Every object of the kinds in Applies to must carry this tag. One without it shows as missing in the tags report.
tagsTab.deleteConfirm: Delete tag "{{id}}"? Its assignments are removed as well.
tagsTab.derivedTagHelp: Derived from each object's own registration and never assigned
tagsTab.purposeBody: A tag is one org-wide label with fixed meaning, applied to sources, tables, columns, relationships, or commands. Tags change behavior: technical keeps a column out of the Data Product export, entity turns a column's values into retrieval vocabulary, deprecated tells consumers to migrate off.
tagsTab.purposeAdd: A tag that applies to several object types is one tag, so editing it in any of the scoped lists edits it in all of them.
